topic: Identifying and assessing risks of material misstatement
question: Explain the risk assessment procedures an auditor performs under SA 315 to identify and assess the risks of material misstatement.
sources: SA 315 Identifying and Assessing the Risks of Material Misstatement

points.label: Purpose of risk assessment procedures
points.description: The auditor performs these procedures to understand the entity, its environment and its internal control, so as to identify and assess risks of material misstatement at the financial statement level and the assertion level. On their own they do not give sufficient appropriate evidence for the opinion.
points.basis: SA 315, risk assessment procedures and related activities

points.label: Inquiries of management and others
points.description: Asks management, those charged with governance, internal audit and other staff (for example legal or sales staff) about the business and possible risks, since different people give different views.
points.basis: SA 315, risk assessment procedures: inquiries of management and others within the entity

points.label: Analytical procedures
points.description: Compares financial and non-financial data, trends and ratios to spot unusual transactions, amounts or relationships that may point to risks of misstatement.
points.basis: SA 315, risk assessment procedures: analytical procedures

points.label: Observation and inspection
points.description: Observes the entity's activities and premises and inspects documents such as business plans, internal control manuals and minutes; these support and test what was learnt from inquiries.
points.basis: SA 315, risk assessment procedures: observation and inspection

points.label: Other information and engagement team discussion
points.description: Uses relevant information from client acceptance or continuance, previous audits and other engagements for the entity; the engagement partner and key team members discuss how the financial statements could be materially misstated.
points.basis: SA 315, other sources of information and discussion among the engagement team
